description: Prior approval. Construction of footbridge, Part 18 Class A of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015. Renewing and construction of footbridge as per the submitted drawings. The footbridge is a steel U-frame construction and follows the principles of the Network Rail Standard Details for Non-Station Footbridges.
street_name: Footpath From 76 Chatsworth Crescent To 49 James Street
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans and documents submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - Prior to the first use of the hereby approved footbridge, the agreed perforated panels and height increase of the parapet shall be implemented in accordance with the email dated 3 November 2020.
